title: migrate: 9 '-- scope: public' migrations write unqualified tables, breaking fresh-database bootstrap at 011 (from ISS-0185/GH#518)
registered_by: ISSUE-FIXER (WF03-GH482-20260809 Step 01, incidental discovery during GH-482/ISS-0150 fresh-database re-measurement)
symptom: zig build migrate against a genuinely fresh, empty database fails at 011_webhook_subscriptions.sql with 'Migration scope mismatch: ... is declared public-only ... but performs unqualified table work that needs the per-tenant pass.' Pre-seeding past 011 reproduces the identical error at the next affected file, 022_obs06_alerting_state.sql, confirming a systemic pattern across at least 9 files.
reproduction: docker exec <db_test-container> psql -U bpm -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE bpm_fresh_check OWNER bpm;"; BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:<port>/bpm_fresh_check zig build migrate  # fails at 011_webhook_subscriptions.sql
root_cause_analysis: Commit a2a8c68 (ISS-0185 / GH #518, merged 2026-08-08, PR #569) added '-- scope: public' headers to 9 numeric migration files as part of dual-schema-shadow cleanup, without qualifying those files' CREATE TABLE / INSERT INTO statements with 'public.'. The scope-mismatch guard (declaresUnqualifiedTableWork() in src/db/migrations.zig, added by ISS-0604/GH-470 specifically to catch this defect class) correctly fires on any fresh apply of these files.
shared_db_masking: Every workspace's db_test container has run continuously since 2026-08-06 (before a2a8c68 merged 2026-08-08), so public.schema_migrations already recorded all 9 files as applied before the defect was introduced into their content. zig build migrate skips already-applied files, so the guard never evaluated the broken content on any long-lived shared database. Only a genuinely fresh database triggers it -- the exact 'shared_db_container_trap' pattern documented in docs/anti-patterns.md from ISS-0150's own resolution.
impact: Fresh-database bootstrap is broken on main. Blocks new developer onboarding, new CI/test infrastructure, disaster recovery, staging cutover, and blocks a trustworthy fresh-database measurement of GH-482 / ISS-0150's own acceptance criterion 2 (zig build test-integration-svc exits 0 against a healthy test database), since the close-out design for that issue (src/design/iss0150-gh482-test-integration-svc-closeout.md) requires a fresh workspace-owned database.
acceptance_criteria: Every migration file identified above either qualifies its unqualified CREATE TABLE/ALTER TABLE/INSERT INTO statements with public., or has its scope header corrected to '-- scope: all_schemas' (public.-qualification expected, since all 9 tables appear genuinely global)
zig build migrate against a genuinely fresh, empty database exits 0 and applies all migration files without a scope-mismatch error

A regression check exists (or is confirmed already present) that migrates a fresh database, not only the long-lived shared one, to prevent recurrence -- this is the second occurrence of this defect class (see ISS-0603/GH-467, ISS-0604/GH-470)
